plainTranslation:
This person likes you. Roots for you, sees the best in you, makes you feel good without you having to earn it. Right away it's obvious this could be one of the easy, happy ones, a connection that adds to your life instead of draining it.

The good feeling won't do the work for you. A little effort goes a long way here, the text that says you were thinking of them, the plan you actually make, saying the nice thing out loud instead of figuring they know. Small stuff, and it adds up fast.

That's the catch with this one. The warmth opens the door and then just stands there. Coast on it, assume it runs itself, and you end up with a great connection you never actually used.

So treat it like anything good. Show up for it. The more you put in, the more this person becomes someone you can count on, instead of a nice thing you let slip.
